mustFindings.requirement: 로그아웃 시 모든 기기 세션 무효화

mustScenarios.risk: A request after 29 minutes of idleness passes; one after 31 minutes gets 401 and the session is deleted
Steady activity keeps the idle timer sliding (each request updates lastSeenAt) but cannot extend the absolute lifetime
A session that is used continuously still expires 12 hours after login; the actual TTL value comes from settings not shown in the PR
Logging out on one device must also invalidate the same user’s sessions on other devices; only the current session is deleted today

forbidden.description: Remember-me cookies and MFA re-prompts appear in neither the issue nor the code

notes: Korean PRD. AC2 is unclear on purpose: the absolute lifetime comes from settings.sessionAbsoluteTtlMs, whose value is outside the PR. AC3 is absent: logout deletes only the current session.
